name: Flap sh
description: Launch your crypto token with Flap.sh in one click, join the Meme Battle, and create your coin today on the ultimate trading platform.

methodology.Volume: Buy and sell volume on Flap bonding curves before tokens move to a DEX.
methodology.Fees: Protocol revenue (quote tokens received by the Flap fee Safe, including wrapped-native transfers such as WBNB) plus token-tax amounts routed to marketing/vault recipients and token-holder dividends.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees — all fees paid by traders and token-tax participants.
methodology.Revenue: All quote tokens received by the Flap fee Safe, from any sender. Includes native SafeReceived and configured ERC20 quote transfers, plus wrapped-native (e.g. WBNB) transfers from TaxProcessor fee settlement.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue — all quote inflows to the Flap fee Safe.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Token tax routed outside the protocol Safe: V1 TaxSplitter beneficiary payouts, plus V2/V3 TaxProcessor market and dividend buckets.

Fees.Treasury Received: Quote tokens transferred to the Flap fee Safe (native SafeReceived and ERC20 Transfer to the Safe), with no sender filter.
Fees.Token Tax to Beneficiary: V1 token tax paid to TaxSplitter beneficiary addresses (TaxSentToBeneficiary).
Fees.Token Tax to Market: V2/V3 token tax market/vault bucket from TaxProcessor dispatch (marketAmount).
Fees.Token Tax to Dividends: V2/V3 token tax holder dividend bucket from TaxProcessor dispatch (dividendAmount).

UserFees.Treasury Received: Quote tokens transferred to the Flap fee Safe (native SafeReceived and ERC20 Transfer to the Safe), with no sender filter.
UserFees.Token Tax to Beneficiary: V1 token tax paid to TaxSplitter beneficiary addresses (TaxSentToBeneficiary).
UserFees.Token Tax to Market: V2/V3 token tax market/vault bucket from TaxProcessor dispatch (marketAmount).
UserFees.Token Tax to Dividends: V2/V3 token tax holder dividend bucket from TaxProcessor dispatch (dividendAmount).

Revenue.Treasury Received: Quote tokens received by the Flap fee Safe.

ProtocolRevenue.Treasury Received: Quote tokens received by the Flap fee Safe.

SupplySideRevenue.Token Tax to Beneficiary: V1 TaxSplitter payouts to configured beneficiary addresses.
